system.description: Your attacks become the ultimate spear, able to penetrate any defense and overwhelm anyone that dares to try and clash with you. Your unarmed and weapon attacks can deal Lightning damage. Melee attacks you make as a result of Hijutsu you cast gain a +1 bonus to their attack rolls and a +2 bonus to their damage rolls. Beginning at 7th level, this expands to your Unarmed and Weapon attacks that deal Lightning damage as well. Beginning at 15th level, the bonus to attacks increases to +2 and the bonus to damage becomes +4.
